title: Make LB Agar Medium
author: Gurdon Institute mediak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.55zg876

steps.title: Prepare LB Solution
steps.instruction: Combine LB mix and distilled water to create the base solution.

substeps.instruction: In the fume cupboard, add 125g of LB mix to 2L of distilled H2O in a bell jar.
Transfer the bell jar to a magnetic stirrer on the bench.
Add distilled H2O to approximately the 4L mark using a jug.

steps.title: Adjust pH and Final Volume
steps.instruction: Ensure the solution is fully dissolved and reaches the correct pH and volume.

substeps.instruction: Adjust pH to 7.0 using a few drops of 10M NaOH.
Adjust the final volume to 5L using distilled H2O.

steps.title: Aliquot and Add Agar
steps.instruction: Distribute the solution into bottles and add the required amount of agar.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot the solution (using a pump), label, and date.
Dispense 14g agar and a magnetic flea to each 1L bottle, OR 7g agar and a magnetic flea to each 500ml bottle.
